name: news_symbol_guard_apostrophe_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: NEWS_SYMBOL_GUARD_APOSTROPHE_20261107 — the news guard's ticker test is the shared exact-symbol matcher (RE-6, LQ-20261107-191): it reads the original case, so "don't" is never the ticker T, a prose word is never an upper-case ticker, T-Mobile and TSX:T are not T; a single-letter ticker is kept by cashtag or company name; a curly-apostrophe company name still matches the profile name.
